test_jittered_backoff_exponential: test that jittered_backoff returns exponentially doubling delays for successive attempts
test_jittered_backoff_max_delay: test that jittered_backoff caps delay at max_delay regardless of attempt number
test_jittered_backoff_jitter: test that jittered_backoff produces varying delays when jitter_ratio is greater than zero
test_jittered_backoff_thread_safety: test that concurrent calls to jittered_backoff produce unique random seeds and delays
test_jittered_backoff_edge_cases: test that jittered_backoff handles zero base_delay, negative attempts, and extreme attempt numbers
